titulo: Humans, not rogue AI, are still the biggest cybersecurity risk to energy systems
cuerpo: Before recent high-profile hacks raised the specter of AI possibly "killing all humans," our energy systems were already disturbingly vulnerable to cyberattack - and the risk is growing.
